params.body:
## What was wrong

Shane: after adding a photo the browser asks "Leave site? Changes you made may not be saved" on a refresh, while photos save themselves.

Reproduced in a running application (local server, seeded dealer and vehicle, Livewire sheet enabled) before changing anything. Of the two candidate causes, **neither was the unsaved-changes flag**:

* Uploading a photo on a clean sheet leaves `dirty` **false**. `markDirty()` deliberately ignores `#car_images`, and the upload posts to a classic endpoint rather than through Livewire, so the commit hook does not fire either. Verified with a `beforeunload` probe: nothing fires.
* The real cause is that **the upload navigated the whole document**. `vehicle_form_preview.blade.php` set `location.href` to the same URL with `?tab=photos&toegevoegd=1` to show the new tile. That navigation is the moment the browser asks its question — and it asks it correctly, because the sheet does hold genuinely unsaved work at that point (a typed video URL, an edited field). The reload then takes exactly what the question was trying to protect. The server log shows the document GET right after the upload POST; the typed video URL comes back empty.

So the dealer saw a question they could not place, and lost real work by answering it.

The same shape was in two more places:

* `photos/image.blade.php` — the per-tile duplicate button did `window.location.href + '&tab=4'`.
* `vehicle.js duplicateSelected` — "duplicate all photos to Stocklist" put the response into `#ownstock_stocklist_photos`, a hidden container, so visibly nothing happened until someone reloaded.

**One claim in the brief did not hold, checked rather than repeated:** `?tab=4` does *not* throw the Livewire sheet back to the first step. `VehicleForm::initialStep()` maps a numeric tab through `STEPS[(int) $wanted]`, so `?tab=4` lands on the photos step. Confirmed in the browser. Nothing was changed about the numeric tab, and `ImageController`'s `session()->flash('tab', 4)` for the classic sheet is untouched.

## What changed

* `photos.blade.php` wraps everything a photo action changes in **`#ui-photo-gallery`**. The video field stays outside it: that is a form field that only leaves on Opslaan.
* `vehicle.js` gets **`refreshPhotos(url)`**: fetch `ownvehicle.index.photos`, swap the block, dispatch `photos-refreshed`, restart the processing poll.
* The upload (`vehicle_form_preview.blade.php`), the per-tile duplicate and the bulk duplicate now call it instead of navigating.
* The upload zone and the tiles live inside the swapped block, so the islands re-bind on `photos-refreshed`. The Livewire sheet's binding moved into `bindFotoEiland()`; the classic `create`/`edit` sheets got the same listener for their `#car_images` uploader, because they share `image.blade.php`'s duplicate button. Their own upload still reloads — that is the classic sheet and out of scope here.
* Delete, reorder, background removal and the background-type choice already ran over AJAX without a reload and are untouched.
* `markDirty` and `volgLivewireSchrijfbeurten` are **unchanged**: they were not broken, and the commit hook is what still counts an AI text fill or a `$set` from a button as a change.

Also fixed: the bulk duplicate now actually shows its copies, and the platform section updates in place.

## What still counts as unsaved

A real edit of a sheet field, by keystroke or by a Livewire write that carries property updates (AI descriptions, `$set` from a button). Verified in the browser: typing a video URL sets the flag, and navigating away then still asks the question.

Not unsaved: uploading, deleting, reordering, removing a background, duplicating to the platform, and the damage and option islands. They save themselves, and none of them leaves the page any more.

## Other places that still append a tab number (not fixed here)

`create.blade.php` (`naarTab`, `?tab=4`), `edit.blade.php` (`ownvehicle.edit ... ?tab=4`), and `ImageController`'s `session()->flash('tab', 4)`. All three belong to the classic sheet, where they still work. The stale-tab-number cleanup is its own job.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/PhotoActionsDoNotReloadTest.php` (5 tests). Whether the browser shows its dialog is browser behaviour and this project has no browser test harness — that half is verified by hand in a running application (screenshots in the report), and the test class says so. What is pinned server-side is the condition under which the question is no longer needed: the gallery is one block the photo tab serves on its own, the video field is outside it (read as DOM, not as text), the sheet tells the island where to refresh from, the rendered photo tab contains no `location.href` / `location.reload` / `location.replace`, the upload handler refreshes instead of reloading and the islands re-bind, and the guard still ignores the self-saving islands while still watching Livewire writes.

`php artisan test --filter='VehicleForm|Photo|Image|OwnStock|AlpineExpression|StylesheetSyntax|RulesCoverage'` → 83 tests, 80 pass. The 3 failures are all in `PlatformPhotosOnShareTest` and are **pre-existing**: they fail identically on the unmodified branch point (a local environment artefact around the image-processing queue).

## Docs

`docs/bedrijfsregels/11-s1-wagen-invoeren-en-beheren.md`: new rule **R S1-9.17** stating which actions do not count as unsaved and why. `docs/bedrijfsregels/90-x-bevindingen.md`: the defect as **X-103** (X-102 was the highest on main). The generated `bedrijfsregels.html` and `92-testdekking-tabel.md` were not regenerated.
params.title: A photo upload no longer warns about unsaved changes
